questions.question: Diffraction arises as a result of?

answers.a: Superposition of primary wave fronts from coherent sources
answers.b: Superposition of primary wave fronts from incoherent sources
answers.c: Superposition of secondary wave fronts from the slits

answers.a: A pattern of intensity variation consisting of equal-width maxima and minima
answers.b: A pattern of intensity variation consisting of unequal -width maxima and minima
